_about: Hand-written SIL rules for JSON lines no generated shape expresses (read by api/_boq_convert.py). Baffle frames: a silencer has half and full baffles; a frame size (87..337) can come from either slot, and one line sums both slots (JSON lines 17/18 etc.). One pooled dimension halfBaffleSlit|fullBaffleSlit does that for every size. Sealant (line 114): JSON item code 2050001 has no cost row; the sealant SIL prices with is row 238.

rule.notes: 18 JSON lines (15-32); a size found in either baffle slot, both slots summed
JSON line 114 (2050001 Sealant): the SIL sealant cost row (decision O3)
